chapter_seo_title: Ji Ning Defeats the Ninth-Stage Puppet – Desolate Era Ch. 0367
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning challenges a ninth-stage puppet on Mount Innerheart, winning on his first try. A pure test of sword technique and Dao comprehension sets the stage for the legendary Three Realms Palace.
og_description: Thirty years of cultivation, three strikes, and a single victory—Ji Ning proves his worth against a creation that can humble Celestial Immortals.
twitter_title: Ji Ning vs. the Ninth-Stage Puppet
twitter_description: A sword fight with no divine abilities, only pure technique and Dao. Ji Ning wins in three moves. 🗡️🔥

lore_anchors.definition: A treasure of the highest recognized grade in the Three Realms, comparable to a fully trained Celestial Immortal; artifacts at this level often develop intelligence and a will of their own.
The ultimate treasury of Patriarch Subhuti, said to hold divine abilities and secret arts so powerful that mastering even one can elevate a cultivator to a legendary figure across the Three Realms.
Ji Ning’s signature offensive technique, refined over decades on Mount Innerheart, which manifests two black dragon-like sword-lights that attack in a coordinated, winding manner.
A senior personal disciple of Patriarch Subhuti, known for his feathered fan and demeanor of confident ease; he serves as Ji Ning’s primary guide and commentator during the puppet trial.
A complete Dao comprehended overnight by the Ninth Apprentice, a painting child who had never cultivated before; a testament to the Patriarch’s ability to recognize latent talent.
The residence of Patriarch Subhuti and his disciples, a hidden sanctuary in the primordial chaos; the setting for Ji Ning’s thirty-year cultivation retreat.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why didn’t Ji Ning use his divine abilities against the puppet?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The trial is a test of pure sword technique and Dao comprehension. Divine abilities and formations are banned, forcing the cultivator to rely on their martial foundation alone—a classic Xianxia ‘mirror match’ trope meant to measure enlightenment rather than brute force.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is special about the ninth-stage puppet?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It is a Pure Yang-level creation by Patriarch Subhuti, comparable to a Celestial Immortal in combat power. It has developed intelligence and a will of its own, making it a worthy opponent for even a personal disciple of the Patriarch.

cultural_notes_faq.q: How long does it usually take personal disciples to beat this puppet?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Among the twelve who started weak, the shortest time was just over a year (the Ninth Apprentice, a painting child genius), and the longest was over thirteen thousand years. Ji Ning’s thirty years place him solidly in the middle—impressive but not unprecedented.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the Three Realms Palace?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It is the Patriarch’s ultimate treasury of divine abilities, located beyond the ninth floor of the Divine Immortal Palace. Mastering a single technique from it can allow a cultivator to dominate the entire Three Realms.
